name: The Deadly Dawn
source:
The year is 2006. You are a lonely college student looking for companionship, but no matter which path you choose, you'll end up finding more than you bargained for...

[From [url=https://awildmartian.itch.io/the-deadly-dawn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
時間是2006年。你是一名孤獨的大學生，渴望找到陪伴。然而，無論選擇哪條路，最後找到的東西都會遠遠超出你的預期……

[摘自[url=https://awildmartian.itch.io/the-deadly-dawn]Itch.io[/url]]
